svg.aria-label: Linking the bank, an exchange between four parties: Smart Budget, Enable Banking, your bank and GitHub Pages. Smart Budget sends Enable Banking a JWT signed with RS256 and a random state; Enable Banking opens the bank’s page; you approve with Safetrans; the bank comes back to GitHub Pages with a code and the state; the page hands back to the app through smartbudget://banque; the app checks the state matches the one it sent, trades the code for a 180-day session and the accounts, then imports twelve months and syncs at every launch.
svg.title: Linking the bank, an exchange between four parties: Smart Budget, Enable Banking, your bank and GitHub Pages. Smart Budget sends Enable Banking a JWT signed with RS256 and a random state; Enable Banking opens the bank’s page; you approve with Safetrans; the bank comes back to GitHub Pages with a code and the state; the page hands back to the app through smartbudget://banque; the app checks the state matches the one it sent, trades the code for a 180-day session and the accounts, then imports twelve months and syncs at every launch.
svg.text: One round trip, once every 180 days. The private key never leaves the phone.

g.text: POST /auth: a JWT signed with RS256, and a random state
the state matches the one sent ✓
12 months imported, then at every launch

svg.text: The state token, random on the way out and checked on the way back, stops a link forged elsewhere from linking another account.
